# Awesome OriginOS

A curated list of **35** tools for Vivo / iQOO devices running OriginOS (and FuntouchOS), with the access level each one needs stated up front.

This is the same list the app shows on its **Discover** screen, shipped from [`catalog/awesome.json`](../catalog/awesome.json). It is community-maintained: if a project moved, was archived or a better alternative exists, open a pull request.

## Access levels

| Badge | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `NO-ROOT` | Works on a stock device, no root, no computer after the first setup. |
| `ADB` | Needs a computer with `adb`, at least for the initial setup. |
| `SHIZUKU` | Uses Shizuku to borrow the shell identity. |
| `ROOT` | Listed for reference: needs root, a Magisk module or LSPosed. |

> Nothing in this list is bundled, forked or modified by OriginOS Toolkit. Links point at the upstream project, and the descriptions are our own paraphrase of what it does.

## Start here — the no-root foundation

_Without one of these two, nothing else in the list can touch system settings._

### [Shizuku](https://github.com/RikkaApps/Shizuku) — `NO-ROOT`

The keystone of the whole no-root ecosystem: starts a privileged shell over wireless debugging or ADB, then lends that access to apps you approve. Every Shizuku-based tool below depends on it.

`RikkaApps/Shizuku` · tags: shizuku, foundation, must-have

### [Android Platform Tools (adb)](https://developer.android.com/tools/releases/platform-tools) — `NO-ROOT`

Official Google ADB binaries. Needed exactly once to bootstrap Shizuku or to run this toolkit's generated command sets from a computer.

`developer.android.com/platform-tools` · tags: adb, foundation, official

### [LADB](https://github.com/tytydraco/LADB) — `NO-ROOT`

A local ADB shell that talks to itself over wireless debugging. Handy escape hatch when a Shizuku session dies and you have no computer nearby.

`tytydraco/LADB` · tags: adb, shell, no-pc

### [Termux](https://github.com/termux/termux-app) — `NO-ROOT`

Full Linux userland on the phone. Pair it with the ADB connection trick and you can script your own tweaks from the device itself.

`termux/termux-app` · tags: shell, automation, linux

<a id="fps-gaming"></a>

## FPS, refresh rate & gaming

_The category this toolkit was born in. OriginOS's high-refresh whitelist is the thing everyone fights._

### [VivoIQOO144FPSUnlocker](https://github.com/ewfawfasdf/VivoIQOO144FPSUnlocker) — `NO-ROOT`

Purpose-built for Vivo/iQOO on OriginOS: forces 144 Hz in apps that are not on the high-refresh whitelist, with a built-in FPS counter. It has an APK mirror listing, which is why it went viral on TikTok in the iQOO community.

`ewfawfasdf/VivoIQOO144FPSUnlocker` · tags: originos, vivo, iqoo, 144hz, fps

### [otweak](https://github.com/Astreas-Core/otweak) — `NO-ROOT`

Indie Kotlin/ADB project for Android customisation with a system-level tweaking bent. Small, active, worth reading for how it layers ADB commands into a UI.

`Astreas-Core/otweak` · tags: originos, kotlin, adb, tweaks

### [FrameX](https://github.com/MaheshSharan/FrameX-Android) — `NO-ROOT`

Overlay with a live FPS meter and thermal diagnostics, driving optimisation through Shizuku. Explicitly targets Vivo OriginOS/FuntouchOS builds.

`MaheshSharan/FrameX-Android` · tags: fps-meter, overlay, thermal, vivo

### [Game Booster / FPS Unlocker](https://github.com/catsmoker/catsmoker-app) — `NO-ROOT`

Game FPS unlocking and device profiling: resolution scaling, an FPS/CPU/RAM/temperature overlay, crosshair overlay and a DNS optimiser. Shizuku for no-root use, LSPosed if you are rooted.

`catsmoker/catsmoker-app` · tags: fps, overlay, resolution, spoofing

### [Android Game Booster](https://github.com/Mathias-Boulay/Android-Game-Booster) — `ADB`

Universal resolution scaler with a one-time ADB setup for non-rooted devices. Claims large frame-rate gains on GPU-bound titles.

`Mathias-Boulay/Android-Game-Booster` · tags: resolution, gaming, adb

### [SystemUI Tuner Redesign](https://github.com/zacharee/SystemUITunerRedesign) — `NO-ROOT`

Long-standing tool for hiding status-bar icons, tuning immersive mode and unlocking flags the OEM hides. Overlaps with this toolkit's display section and does it with more polish.

`zacharee/SystemUITunerRedesign` · tags: ui, status-bar, immersive

## Optimisation & tuning

_Profiles, schedulers and kernel-ish tuning with varying degrees of honesty about what a no-root device can do._

### [NRAO — Non-Root Android Optimizer](https://github.com/iamlooper/NRAO) — `NO-ROOT`

Optimiser that works purely with shell-accessible knobs, no root required. Exactly what the name says.

`iamlooper/NRAO` · tags: optimizer, no-root

### [ADB Android Optimizer](https://github.com/SchneeSchmitt/ADB-Android-Optimizer) — `ADB`

Ships power-saving, balanced and max-hardware profiles as ADB command sets, with Shizuku/Shizushell support so you only need a PC for the first setup.

`SchneeSchmitt/ADB-Android-Optimizer` · tags: profiles, adb, shizuku

### [Android battery optimization](https://github.com/Aatricks/Android-battery-optimizer) — `ADB`

Focused ADB recipes that maximise battery life and screen-on time on a stock, non-rooted device without deep system modification.

`Aatricks/Android-battery-optimizer` · tags: battery, sot, adb

### [AndroidTweaker](https://github.com/c0d3h01/AndroidTweaker) — `ROOT`

Universal Magisk module that balances kernel and RAM behaviour with configurable profiles and no terminal work. Listed for reference — it is the rooted counterpart to what this toolkit does.

`c0d3h01/AndroidTweaker` · tags: magisk, kernel, root-only

### [CoreTaskOptimizer](https://github.com/c0d3h01/CoreTaskOptimizer) — `ROOT`

CPU affinity, scheduler priority and I/O policy management that detects performance versus efficiency cores at runtime. Root-only, but the detection logic is worth studying.

`c0d3h01/CoreTaskOptimizer` · tags: magisk, scheduler, root-only

### [KTweak](https://github.com/tytydraco/KTweak) — `ROOT`

The most-referenced kernel tuning script in the Android community. Included as the canonical reference for what root buys you — and what this toolkit deliberately cannot do.

`tytydraco/KTweak` · tags: kernel, script, root-only

## Debloat & app management

_Disable what you do not want without touching a system partition._

### [Universal Android Debloater](https://github.com/0x192/universal-android-debloater) — `ADB`

Cross-platform Rust GUI that debloats over ADB. Improves privacy, security and battery, and is designed so that you cannot brick the device.

`0x192/universal-android-debloater` · tags: debloat, rust, gui, adb

### [Universal Android Debloater NG](https://github.com/Universal-Debloater-Alliance/universal-android-debloater-next-generation) — `ADB`

The maintained next-generation rewrite of the debloater. Better multi-user support and a cleaner package database.

`Universal-Debloater-Alliance/universal-android-debloater-next-generation` · tags: debloat, adb, multi-user

### [App Manager](https://github.com/MuntashirAkon/AppManager) — `NO-ROOT`

The Swiss-army knife for package introspection: permissions, trackers, activities, app ops, and ADB-mode freeze/uninstall. Does more than this toolkit ever will, with a steeper learning curve.

`MuntashirAkon/AppManager` · tags: app-ops, freeze, trackers, adb-mode

### [Hail](https://github.com/aistra0528/Hail) — `NO-ROOT`

Freeze, unfreeze and hibernate apps through Shizuku or root. The cleanest way to make bloatware inert without uninstalling anything.

`aistra0528/Hail` · tags: freeze, shizuku, hibernate

### [Canta](https://github.com/samolego/Canta) — `NO-ROOT`

Single-purpose Shizuku debloater with a curated list of packages that are safe to remove per vendor — including Vivo entries.

`samolego/Canta` · tags: debloat, shizuku, vivo

### [Obtainium](https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium) — `NO-ROOT`

Installs and updates apps straight from GitHub, F-Droid and other sources. The practical way to keep all the sideloaded tools in this list current.

`ImranR98/Obtainium` · tags: updates, f-droid, github-releases

### [SAI — Split APKs Installer](https://github.com/Aefyr/SAI) — `NO-ROOT`

Installs split APK bundles (XAPK/APKS) without root or a PC. Most modern phone APKs you find online are split, and the system installer will refuse them.

`Aefyr/SAI` · tags: installer, xapk, sideload

## Privacy, firewall & tracking

_Who is talking to your phone, and how to stop the boring half of it._

### [NetGuard](https://github.com/M66B/NetGuard) — `NO-ROOT`

No-root firewall that blocks network access per app through the local VPN slot. The single most effective privacy tool you can install without root.

`M66B/NetGuard` · tags: firewall, vpn-slot, no-root

### [TrackerControl](https://github.com/TrackerControl/tracker-control-android) — `NO-ROOT`

Shows which trackers each app contacts and lets you block them individually. Excellent companion to a debloat session for understanding what you just disabled.

`TrackerControl/tracker-control-android` · tags: trackers, firewall, transparency

### [εxodus](https://github.com/Exodus-Privacy/exodus-android-app) — `NO-ROOT`

Reports the trackers embedded in any installed app, using the Exodus Privacy static-analysis database.

`Exodus-Privacy/exodus-android-app` · tags: trackers, audit

### [Intra](https://github.com/Jigsaw-Code/Intra) — `NO-ROOT`

Encrypted-DNS client from Jigsaw. A UI-first alternative to this toolkit's Private DNS tweak if you prefer a per-app, switchable setup.

`Jigsaw-Code/Intra` · tags: dns, dot, encryption

### [awesome-shizuku](https://github.com/timschneeb/awesome-shizuku) — `NO-ROOT`

The canonical curated index of Shizuku-powered apps: debloat, audio, display, automation and more. If an app in our list has a better alternative, it is probably on that page.

`timschneeb/awesome-shizuku` · tags: awesome-list, shizuku, index

### [best Shizuku apps for no-root](https://github.com/krishna3163/best_shizuku_apps_for_android_no_root) — `NO-ROOT`

Another community index of Shizuku and wireless-ADB tools, with a heavier emphasis on automation and customisation.

`krishna3163/best_shizuku_apps_for_android_no_root` · tags: awesome-list, shizuku, wireless-adb

## Display, launcher & audio

_The parts of customisation that never needed root in the first place._

### [Wavelet](https://github.com/Pittvandewitt/Wavelet) — `NO-ROOT`

System-wide audio effects headphone profile, bass boost and auto-EQ, built on the official DynamicsProcessing API. No root, no audio HAL patching.

`Pittvandewitt/Wavelet` · tags: audio, eq, headphones

### [RootlessJamesDSP](https://github.com/timschneeb/RootlessJamesDSP) — `NO-ROOT`

JamesDSP's convolution and bass processing without root, using the audio playback capture API. The most capable no-root DSP available.

`timschneeb/RootlessJamesDSP` · tags: audio, dsp, no-root

### [Lawnchair](https://github.com/LawnchairLauncher/lawnchair) — `NO-ROOT`

AOSP-based launcher that brings a Pixel-like (or entirely your own) home screen to OriginOS, which is often the single biggest visual upgrade available.

`LawnchairLauncher/lawnchair` · tags: launcher, pixel, theming

### [scrcpy](https://github.com/Genymobile/scrcpy) — `ADB`

Low-latency screen mirroring and control over ADB, no root and no app installed on the phone. Essential for testing tweaks without picking the device up.

`Genymobile/scrcpy` · tags: mirroring, adb, debug

### [DSU Sideloader](https://github.com/VegaBobo/DSU-Sideloader) — `NO-ROOT`

Boots a GSI or a second Android image through Dynamic System Updates without erasing your data. The safest way to try a different ROM before committing.

`VegaBobo/DSU-Sideloader` · tags: dsu, gsi, rom

### [CunnyPlayground](https://github.com/theVakhovskeIsTaken/CunnyPlayground) — `NO-ROOT`

An interactive lab for Android 16's Live Updates API and for OEM dynamic-island clones, with a recaster that re-posts notifications you already receive as a Live Update, as a HyperIsland island, or — on the experimental branch — as a vivo OriginIsland. Live Updates are AOSP and work on any Android 16 build; HyperIsland speaks Xiaomi's miui.focus.param JSON and needs HyperOS. The vivo half lives on the originos-experimental branch: it drives OriginOS 6's island around the camera cutout through the notification.superx.* notification extras (fixed left template, a right template among six, a progress variant) and builds on the HyperIsland Toolkit. Every island payload is silently ignored on ROMs that do not implement it, so check which half you are testing. Needs Android 16 and a notification-listener grant; treat it as instrumentation rather than a daily driver.

`theVakhovskeIsTaken/CunnyPlayground` · tags: live-updates, notifications, android16, hyperisland, originisland, recaster, playground

## Contributing an entry

1. It must be open source, or at least free to use, and hosted somewhere permanent.
2. State the access level honestly: if it needs root, say so.
3. Describe what it does in your own words. No marketing copy.
4. Add it to `catalog/awesome.json`, then run `python scripts/generate_docs.py`.

Full project: [https://github.com/cameleonnbss/originos-toolkit](https://github.com/cameleonnbss/originos-toolkit)
